name: rohas-legal-ai
description: The complete Rohas Legal AI skill library for lawyers in a single plugin, covering contracts, disputes and litigation, arbitration and ADR, corporate, regulatory, privacy, criminal, employment, property, tax, finance, insolvency, IP, startup, public law, research, investigations, and practice-management workflows.

interface.longDescription: One installable plugin containing the full Rohas Legal AI skill library. Install once and describe your legal task normally — the right skill across contracts, disputes, corporate, regulatory, privacy, criminal, employment, property, tax and more is selected automatically. No need to know or invoke individual skill names.
defaultPrompt: Review this MSA from the Buyer's side and rank the most important risks.
Draft a demand notice for unpaid invoices with a 15-day deadline.
Assess our DPDP compliance position for this processing activity.
